text: beaten down: Heb. broken in pieces | fled apace: Heb. fled a flight
Ethiopians: Heb. Cush | Lybians: Heb. Put
not be cured: Heb. no cure shall be unto thee
he made many to fall: Heb. multiplied the faller
furnish thyself to go into captivity: Heb. make thee instruments of captivity
fatted bullocks: Heb. bullocks of the stall
yet will I not leave thee: Or, not utterly cut thee off
